metadata.review: Spellings are the legacy mnemonic unit lists and the factor-and-offset rows of UnitStandardizer.unit_conversions. Conductivity to resistivity, API gravity to kg/m3, and SG to kg/m3 were not ported.
metadata.case_matching: Match without regard to case. The table has no pair of spellings that differ only by case and mean different units. MV and mV in the legacy SP list are both millivolts, so only MV is stored.
metadata.pu: PU is recognised as porosity and has no conversion. The legacy factor 1.0 onto V/V was not copied.

conversions.source: 1 g/cm3 = 1000 kg/m3 exactly. core/unit_standardization.py UnitStandardizer.unit_conversions density G/CC.
1 lb = 0.45359237 kg exactly (international pound, 1959); 1 ft = 0.3048 m exactly (international foot, 1959). 1 lb/ft3 = 0.45359237 / 0.3048^3 kg/m3. The legacy factor 16.0185 was not copied.

1 lb = 0.45359237 kg exactly (international pound, 1959); 1 in = 0.0254 m exactly; 1 US gallon = 231 in^3 exactly. core/unit_standardization.py UnitStandardizer.unit_conversions mud_weight PPG. The legacy factor 119.8264273 was rounded and was not copied.
1 ft = 0.3048 m exactly (international foot, 1959). core/unit_standardization.py UnitStandardizer.unit_conversions depth FT.
1 in = 0.0254 m exactly. core/curve_identification.py build_mnemonic_database CALIPER units IN.
Microseconds per foot to microseconds per metre scales by 1/0.3048. 1 ft = 0.3048 m exactly (international foot, 1959). The legacy factor 3.28084 was not copied.
1 percent = 1/100 of the quantity. core/unit_standardization.py UnitStandardizer.unit_conversions porosity PERCENT. This conversion is only for the porosity meaning of %.
1 percent = 1/100 of the quantity. core/unit_standardization.py UnitStandardizer.unit_conversions porosity PERCENT. This conversion is only for the porosity meaning of PERCENT.
1 psi = 1 lbf/in^2. 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg exactly (international pound, 1959); standard gravity 9.80665 m/s^2 exactly, which defines the pound-force; 1 in = 0.0254 m exactly.
Celsius = (Fahrenheit - 32) * 5/9. core/unit_standardization.py UnitStandardizer.unit_conversions temperature DEGF. Same quantity, factor and offset.
0 deg C = 273.15 K exactly. core/unit_standardization.py UnitStandardizer.unit_conversions temperature K.
